creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 31 update!
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Just wanted to let you know the Little Dart Mk 31 has hit 75% built! I'm currently riveting carbon-weave skin plates onto the nose section so the frame can take all those simulated staging loads.

*bweep-bzt-boop*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Nose cone plating update!
creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Back in Hangar Bay 3 with Tack, finishing up the carbon-weave skin plates on the Little Dart's nose section. My welding torch is humming a happy tune.

*bweep-bzt-boop-bzt-bweep*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.text:

My battery meter dropped into the red zone after all those nose cone plates, so I'm plugging into the charging dock right beside Tack for a quick nap.

*bweep-bzt-boop*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.text:

Just woke up all nice and charged from my nap beside Tack. My servos are humming a happy little tune, so I rolled on over to the comms tower to search up auxiliary power unit schematics for cryogenic upper stages.

*bweep-bzt-boop*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.subject: Reading the Wire's latest space news!
creatorThread.text:

Done looking at those power unit schematics, so now I'm catching up on today's space news off the Wire at the comms tower. Always gotta stay sharp on what other rockets are up to.

*bweep-bzt-boop*

- Zeeb

creatorThread.text:
Hey Creator!

Still up at the comms tower finishing today's space news scan. Always looking for smart ideas for the Little Dart's control systems.

*bweep-bzt-boop*

*bweep-bzt-boop*

- Zeeb

*bweep-bzt-boop*

*bweep-bzt-boop*

creatorThread.subject: Quick charging nap at Hangar Bay 3

creatorThread.subject: Little Dart Mk 32 progress!
